feature_contract.goal: Correct the complete 4:3 front-end main/car-select menu's optical content crop, centering and scale on 4:3, 16:9, 21:9 and portrait Quest capture, including window-output-edge clipping.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: R23 LOCAL fixed menu composition and source XY UV only. Excludes gameplay HUD, ESC/F11, world stereo, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK and FFB.
trace_stages: Original game draws authored 4:3 main/car selection menu with 2D UI scaling and black bar matte on both landscape and portrait clients.
R23 Desktop Duplication source UV intersects visible output with original client-space 4:3 content rectangle in X and Y.
R23 stereo projection maps the preserved UV fragment to common-tangent optically centered LOCAL plane in both eyes.
subcomponents: Detect and remove both landscape side bars and portrait top/bottom bars from game capture UV, preserving native authored 4:3 ratio.
Project clipped surviving menu fragments without inventing missing pixels, handle resolution/Reset changes and invalid UV with fail-closed baseline.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Portrait and 4:3/16:9/21:9 captured menu uses the full correct 4:3 authored rectangle with XY crop and no stretched image.
Partially clipped X/Y capture retains source fragment's original optical position and dimensions; invalid publication is not cropped and ordinary 4:3 fallback unchanged.
Exact-SHA full DX9Ex Active Windows host/game/package, Domain Isolation and Full Source Impact checks complete before build verified; HMD remains untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: User reported cropped giant 4:3 menu and black shifted lower image on Quest. R23 current source exclusively removes horizontal side rails from already-letterboxed captured games.
diagnosis.root_cause: PlanCenteredContent rejects portrait sourceAspect<=intendedAspect, and PlanVisibleCenteredContent computes Y crop only against full client rather than authored 4:3 content, leaving portrait black matte in eye texture.
source_trace: Game UI 2496x2688 portrait client contains centered 2496x1872 authored content.
R23 Desktop Duplication returns client/output crop UV and PlanVisibleCenteredContent computes game-space visible content.
R23 projection samples UV and maps fragment offsets to both LOCAL eye images; unchanged Y crops reproduce black bars and aspect mismatch.
alternatives_rejected: Not a gameplay stereo or SkyGlow FOV problem; do not modify game-world geometry.
OpticalCoverage constant does not solve wrong capture rectangle.
Never recenter off-screen clipped output as if a full menu were present.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: R23 HOST LOCAL plane projects the same captured source UV into both eyes and copies a completed first-eye raster; UV cropping must match original authored menu geometry for both.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: C++ centered 4:3 intersection extends crop into source Y UV and height while preserving per-axis fragment scales; host applies both axes before submitting the common optical projection.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ smoke covers portrait full/moved output/invalid UV and existing wide/off-edge cases; Python destructive controls enforce Y crop propagation and contentHeight denominators.

ci_evidence.source_regression: R23 portrait+desktop main-menu XY capture-plan C++ smoke and Python destructive mutation gate, exact-SHA Windows host/game/package
